whyChoose.heading: Why Choose Scenic River Cruises?
paragraphs: Scenic is designed for travelers who want a seamless luxury experience with very few additional expenses once onboard. Instead of worrying about additional charges throughout the trip, Scenic focuses on providing an effortless vacation experience from arrival through departure.

whatMakesDifferent.title: What Makes Scenic Different?
whatMakesDifferent.subtitle: Seamless Luxury With Very Few Out-of-Pocket Expenses
paragraphs: Scenic is designed for travelers who want a seamless luxury experience with very few additional expenses once onboard. Unlike many cruise lines that offer optional upgrades, Scenic includes many premium experiences in the cruise fare, making budgeting much easier for travelers.

destinations.title: Scenic Destinations & Itineraries
destinations.subtitle: Scenic offers iconic itineraries across the world's most storied European and Southeast Asian waterways.

items.title: The Danube
items.description: Scenic's Danube sailings glide past grand imperial capitals and quiet vineyard villages, making it one of the line's most popular classic European itineraries.

items.title: The Rhine
items.description: Sailing the Rhine takes guests past storybook riverside towns, vineyard-covered hillsides, and some of Europe's most walkable historic city centers.

items.title: The Rhône
items.description: Scenic's Rhône itineraries lean into Provençal light, lavender-scented countryside, and some of France's most celebrated vineyards.

items.title: The Seine
items.description: Cruising the Seine pairs the romance of Paris with the quiet charm of Normandy, blending world-class art and history with the French countryside.

items.title: The Douro
items.description: Portugal's Douro Valley unfolds in terraced vineyards and sun-soaked hillsides, offering one of Europe's most scenic and intimate river journeys.

items.title: The Mekong
items.description: Scenic's Southeast Asia sailings combine luxury river cruising with immersive culture along the Mekong, connecting vibrant cities with rural village life.

suites.heading: Suites & Accommodations
paragraphs: Scenic suites are among the finest in river cruising. Many suites feature Scenic's signature Sun Lounge, allowing guests to convert their private balcony into an all-weather conservatory at the touch of a button, enjoying fresh air and panoramic views regardless of the weather.
suites.badgeDescription: Floor-to-ceiling glass balconies convert into open-air viewing sanctuaries instantly.

faqs.question: Is Scenic an all-inclusive river cruise line?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic includes many premium amenities, such as butler service, beverages, gratuities, excursions, and airport transfers, creating a comprehensive luxury experience.

faqs.question: Which rivers does Scenic sail?
faqs.answer: Scenic operates on the Danube, Rhine, Rhône, Seine, Douro, and Mekong rivers.

faqs.question: Is Scenic good for first-time river cruisers?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Its all-inclusive approach and attentive service make it an excellent choice for travelers new to river cruising.

faqs.question: Are drinks included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Premium beverages are generally included throughout the cruise.

faqs.question: Is butler service included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Butler service is available for every suite.

faqs.question: What is Scenic Freechoice?
faqs.answer: Scenic Freechoice allows guests to select excursions based on their interests rather than following a single scheduled tour.

faqs.question: What is Scenic Enrich?
faqs.answer: Scenic Enrich consists of exclusive cultural events and experiences created specifically for Scenic guests.

faqs.question: Is Scenic suitable for couples?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic is especially popular with couples seeking a luxurious, romantic river cruise.

faqs.question: How does Scenic compare with Riverside?
faqs.answer: Scenic is known for its comprehensive all-inclusive experience, while Riverside emphasizes boutique luxury, spacious suites, and personalized hospitality. The best choice depends on your travel preferences.

faqs.question: Should I book through a travel advisor?
faqs.answer: Yes. A luxury travel advisor can compare itineraries, recommend the best suite, explain promotions, and coordinate every aspect of your vacation.

faqs.question: What is the dress code onboard Scenic river cruises?
faqs.answer: The onboard dress code is casual and comfortable during the day, and smart casual in the evenings. There are no formal nights, so formal wear like suits and evening gowns are not required.

faqs.question: Are laundry services available on Scenic ships?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic offers onboard laundry services. Depending on your suite category, complimentary laundry service (ranging from a limited number of items to unlimited daily laundry) is provided by your butler.
